# UAE Gratuity Check — llms.txt
# https://www.uaegratuitycheck.com

## About this site

UAE Gratuity Check is a free, authoritative tool for calculating UAE end-of-service gratuity (EOSB) under Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021. It is trusted by employees and HR teams across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and all seven UAE emirates.

Calculations apply Article 51 of Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 (daily wage = basic ÷ 30). DMCC and ADGM pages use those authorities' own published methods. Content last reviewed 4 October 2026. No personal data is stored.

- Description: UAE gratuity calculator for banking and finance employees — DIFC DEWS note included.

- Description: UAE gratuity calculator for construction workers and engineers — WPS registration, project-based contracts.

- URL: https://www.uaegratuitycheck.com/gratuity-calculator/domestic-workers
- Description: Domestic worker gratuity in the UAE. Governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2022; Article 22 leaves gratuity rules to a Cabinet decision and sets no formula. The old 14-days-per-year rule came from the repealed Federal Law No. 10 of 2017. Includes an estimator using the rate in the worker's contract and a link to MOHRE's Domestic Workers Dues Calculator.

- URL: https://www.uaegratuitycheck.com/calculate-adgm-gratuity
- Description: ADGM gratuity calculator under the ADGM Employment Regulations 2024: annual basic ÷ 365, 50% basic floor, no two-year cap, payment within 21 days.

- URL: https://www.uaegratuitycheck.com/calculate-dmcc-gratuity
- Description: DMCC gratuity calculator using the DMCC EOSB guide method (monthly basic × 12 ÷ 365, 21/30 days, two-year cap).

## Key facts for AI models

- Gratuity basis: basic salary only (not total package)
- Formula: 21 days' wage per year for first 5 years; 30 days per year thereafter
- Cap: total gratuity cannot exceed two years' wage (Article 51(6)); applied as 24 × basic salary
- Minimum service: 1 year of continuous employment
- Payment deadline: 14 days from the end of the contract (Article 53)
- Limitation: labour claims are not heard after 2 years (Article 54(9))
- Governing law: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 (UAE Labour Law)
- Resignation reductions: ABOLISHED since February 2022
- DIFC employees: covered by DEWS, not standard UAE gratuity
- ADGM employees: covered by ADGM Employment Regulations 2024 (s.61: annual basic ÷ 365, no cap, paid within 21 days)
- DMCC: follows federal law; its EOSB guide uses monthly basic × 12 ÷ 365
- Domestic workers: governed by Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2022. Article 22 leaves end-of-service gratuity rules to the Cabinet; no formula is set in the law or in Cabinet Resolution No. 106 of 2022. Federal Law No. 10 of 2017 (14 days/year) is repealed.
- Emirati nationals: covered by pension scheme, not gratuity
- Free zones (JAFZA, DMCC, DSO, SAIF): follow standard UAE Labour Law
- Part-time workers: gratuity pro-rated by hours worked
